We have a hotel just opposite to the masjid, and we have a jamat on each floor of the hotel building, The suff is broken ?. Is our namaz Jiaz ?? Question: As salam ali kum N A M A Z During the Jumma Manaz in the main mosque, The Nukhuda masdij, the Jamat spills out on the road and in the neighboring buildings. We have a hotel just opposite to the masjid, and we have a jamat on each floor of the hotel building, The suff is broken ?. Is our namaz Jiaz ?? Answer ID: 25838 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2229/1503/H=1431) No talaq took place with the sentence "I will divorce". However, avoid uttering such sentences in future, lest you utter any words that may cause talaq to take place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
